test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which article of the Indian Constitution declares Hindi as the language of the Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 343(1)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 343(1)** of the Indian Constitution declares that the official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script.
 
• The Constitution also allowed the use of English for official purposes for a period of 15 years from the commencement of the Constitution.
 
• Article 343(1) was enacted to ensure a smooth transition from English to Hindi as the official language of the Union.
 
• The provision was part of the broader objective to promote Hindi as a unifying language while respecting the linguistic diversity of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 29(2)**

 
 
• This article guarantees the right of citizens to conserve their distinct language, script, or culture.
 
• It also ensures non-discrimination in admission to educational institutions maintained by the State or receiving aid out of State funds.
 
 
 
• **Article 29(1)**
 
 
• Article 29(1) provides protection to the interests of minorities by guaranteeing them the right to conserve their distinct language, script, or culture.
 
 
 
• **Article 343(2)**
 
 
• This article allows for the continued use of English for official purposes even after the 15-year period mentioned in Article 343(1), if Parliament by law provides for it.
